blocks.text: EEG dimagh ki barqi sargarmi naapta hai; is ka usool neurons ke darmiyan guzarte nerve impulses ko pakarna hai.

items: Tareeqa: dhaat ke electrodes sar ki jild par lagaye aur amplifier se jore jate hain, jo signals bare karta hai; yeh record ho kar screen ya kaghaz par lehron ki shakal mein dikhte hain.
Istemal: dauron, mirgi (epilepsy) aur brain tumours ki jaanch. Yeh bila dard hai aur behoshi ki dawa ki zaroorat nahi.

blocks.alt: Teen panel. EEG: sar ki jild par electrodes jo amplifier se jure hain, aur paanch lehrein gamma, beta, alpha, theta aur delta, tez se aahista. CT: mez par mareez ke gird chhalla-numa gantry, oopar X-ray tube jo mareez ke gird ghoomti aur saamne detectors. MRI: mez par mareez ke gird taqatwar magnet wala tube-numa scanner, aur radio waves jo hydrogen atoms se signal dilwati hain.
blocks.caption: Electroencephalography (Figure 15.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: EEG dimagh ki barqi sargarmi record karta hai: sar par electrodes signal pakarte, amplifier unhein bara karta aur woh lehron ki shakal mein dikhte hain; yeh bila dard hai aur dauron, mirgi aur rasolion ke liye istemal hota hai. CT scan mareez ke gird ghoomti tube se X-rays bhejta hai; detectors naapte hain ke har tissue kitna jazb karta hai aur computer tarash wali tasveerein banata hai. MRI taqatwar magnetic field aur radio waves istemal karta hai: tissues ke hydrogen atoms signal dete hain jinhein computer tafseeli teen-jihati tasveeron mein badalta hai, khaas kar dimagh aur spinal cord jaise naram tissues ki.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Zyada tar hawale theta lehron ko ghanoodgi aur halki neend se, aur delta lehron ko gehri, be-khwab neend se jorte hain; wazeh khwab zyada tar REM neend mein aate hain, jis ka EEG jaagne (beta jaisi) halat jaisa lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: EEG mirgi ke liye kyun mufeed hai?
blocks.explanation: Mirgi ke dauray dimagh mein ghair maamooli barqi sargarmi ke jhatke hain, jinhein EEG seedha aur bila dard record karta hai.

items: EEG: sar par electrodes, amplifier, lehrein; dauron, mirgi, tumours ke liye; bila dard. Lehrein: gamma, beta, alpha, theta, delta.
